caption: The drawing depicts a single blue skirt, centrally positioned against a plain, light-colored background. The skirt appears to be made of fabric and has a gathered waistband with two blue drawstrings extending from either side at the top. The fabric is predominantly blue with an ornamental pattern that includes motifs resembling leaves or feathers in shades of green, yellow, and blue arranged vertically around the skirt. The bottom portion of the skirt features a decorative border with a repeating pattern of curved shapes and more intricate detailing in green, yellow, and blue hues. The drawing is realistic in style, emphasizing the texture and folds of the fabric, and there are no other objects or elements in the composition. The artist's signature is visible in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Skirt
